title: Bengali Babu Culture Café
subtitle: Conceptual Heritage-Themed Cafeteria Design
description: A conceptual café interior inspired by the Babu culture of old Calcutta, combining mustard-yellow walls, a black-and-white checkerboard floor and a dark timber beamed ceiling with arched niches, stained-glass fanlights, a gramophone corner, vintage photographs and a Bengal folk-style mural.
body:
This conceptual café explores the Babu culture of old Calcutta, the world of mansion drawing rooms, gramophone evenings, adda over tea and an easy, cultivated leisure, and translates it into a contemporary cafeteria.

A warm mustard-yellow envelope, a black-and-white checkerboard floor and a dark timber beamed ceiling set the base palette. Arched niches finished in textured terracotta plaster run along the walls, each spot-lit to display a fragment of the era: a gramophone and vinyl, a hookah, a walking stick, a chess set, books and vintage letter boxes.

The entrance corridor opens with a gallery wall of antique gilded frames, a rotary telephone and a carved timber mirror, while stained-glass fanlights recall the coloured windows of old Kolkata homes. Inside, a collage of old Calcutta photographs and a full-length Bengal folk-style mural turn the dining hall into a place where guests eat and talk surrounded by the city's memory.
features.0.title: An Old-Calcutta Welcome
features.0.text: The entrance corridor sets the story. A gallery wall of antique gilded frames, a rotary telephone on a period console and a tall carved timber mirror recall the drawing rooms of old Calcutta mansions, all set against mustard-yellow walls and a classic checkerboard floor.
features.1.title: The Gramophone Corner
features.1.text: The heart of the dining hall is an arched niche with textured terracotta plaster, framing a gramophone and vinyl record on a carved console. Beside it, a collage of old Calcutta photographs in weathered frames brings the city's streets, ghats and mansions into the café.
features.2.title: A Hall Lined with Bengal Folk Art
features.2.text: One long wall carries a Bengal folk-style mural of figures, umbrellas and palms in warm earthy tones. Ladder-back timber chairs with cream seats and pedestal tables run beneath a dark timber beamed ceiling with black track spotlights, giving the hall a warm, nostalgic glow.
features.3.title: Niches of Babu Life
features.3.text: A row of spot-lit arched niches displays the props of a Babu's leisure, from a hookah and a walking stick to a chess set, alongside a bookshelf and vintage letter boxes, so diners sit among small stories of the era.
